description.en: Verified npm metadata and commit-pinned Git bundles from the community catalog. Inclusion is not a security review.
description.zh: 从社区精选目录核实 npm 元数据及固定提交的 Git 组合包；收录不代表安全审查。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go
plugins.title: dsh-opencode-go
plugins.description: OpenCode Go model provider and settings UI for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-auto-review
plugins.title: dsh-auto-review
plugins.description: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router
plugins.title: dsh-vision-router
plugins.description: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain + pixel-level tools. Remote vision providers, including the default free fallback, receive image content unless strict local-only use is configured.

plugins.name: dsh-permission-rules
plugins.title: dsh-permission-rules
plugins.description: Declarative Claude Code-style permission rules plus a Codex-style process-level network policy for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask rules with tool-name, argument (glob/regex), workspace-path, and network-target (domain/ip/port/scheme) matching on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy governing shell subprocess traffic, three network modes mapped onto the official sandbox presets, full session-log audit, HMR rule reload, and a settings page with a rule editor, block counters, and recent interception lists.
plugins.author: dsh-permission-rules contributors

description.en: Context insights and management, with dashboard, browser, dynamics and commands, for understanding how the context composites, and how it evolves.
description.zh: 上下文洞察与管理插件：提供跨会话的上下文仪表盘、上下文浏览器、上下文动态、/context 命令，看清上下文的构成与演变。

plugins.name: dsh-pentester
plugins.title: dsh-pentester
plugins.description: Minimal Root-Orchestrator PTES pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-research-report
plugins.title: dsh-research-report
plugins.description: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: a content-addressed evidence ledger (claim — snapshot binding, tamper-evident) plus versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory. Retrieval orchestration reuses the official ctx.web / ctx.jobs seams — no deep-research loop.
plugins.author: dsh-research-report contributors

plugins.name: dsh-industry-research
plugins.title: dsh-industry-research
plugins.description: Industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: methodology skills, an industry-chain structure model (industry_map), public-source policy/news tracking over ctx.web (industry_track), company scan cards (company_scan), and auditable research reports with an optional ctx.researchReport sealing bridge and a builtin Markdown fallback (industry_report). Research only — not investment advice.
plugins.author: dsh-industry-research contributors

plugins.name: dsh-im-companion
plugins.title: dsh-im-companion
plugins.description: dsh-im-companion：以助理和家的概念增强 dsh-im——哪个工作区有助理在管、在不在线尽收眼底，搬家拖一下就行。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-bridge
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-bridge
plugins.description: Previewable cross-preset session migration for DeepSeek Harness with bounded, fixed-schema handoffs

plugins.name: dsh-undo-savepoint
plugins.title: dsh-undo-savepoint
plugins.description: DSH undo/rollback system: snapshot config files on change, undo/redo the last action from the WebUI or by chat, and roll back broken plugin trees without reinstalling. Works even when DSH fails to boot (offline CLI + GUI).

description.en: Swaps Windows' PowerShell shell for Git for Windows bash: a bash-sandbox-compatible executor, a unified MSYS path dialect across every tool (posixPaths and friends, live-editable), and the four * Git Bash agent presets declared straight onto the roster on dsh 0.1.7+.
description.zh: 把 Windows 的 PowerShell shell 换成 Git for Windows bash:兼容 bash-sandbox 的执行器、全工具统一的 MSYS 路径方言(posixPaths 等开关可实时编辑),以及 dsh 0.1.7+ 上直接声明进取的四个 * · Git Bash 预设。

plugins.name: dsh-checkpoint-rewind
plugins.title: dsh-checkpoint-rewind
plugins.description: Unified DSH checkpoints: session + workspace + config three-state snapshots with one-shot rollback — /checkpoint and /rewind commands, a checkpoint tool, automatic interval snapshots, a Settings page timeline with pairwise diffs, and seed-replay session rollback via the official sessions.create API
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-fund-research
plugins.title: dsh-fund-research
plugins.description: Research plugin for Chinese public mutual funds on DeepSeek Harness: collects fund data from public sources (Tiantian Fund / Eastmoney), computes deterministic metrics (manager profile, holdings penetration, style attribution, performance decomposition), and seals versioned Markdown research reports whose every key number traces back to a hashed source snapshot. Research only — no trading, no investment advice.
plugins.author: dsh-fund-research contributors

description.en: Unofficial Command Code provider: live model catalog, multi-account rotation, usage dashboard, and a plans & quota panel.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 提供方：实时模型目录、多账号轮换、用量面板与套餐配额面板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-teamflow
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-teamflow
plugins.description: TeamFlow 团队研发流水线（TypeScript）：需求→PRD→设计→架构→技术方案→并行开发→QA→验收；backlog 持久化 + 断点续跑 + 完成汇报 + 防假交付；Web 团队工作台（conversation.view tab + 拖拽看板）

plugins.name: dsh-lsp-actions
plugins.title: dsh-lsp-actions
plugins.description: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integration backend
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-session-sync
plugins.title: dsh-session-sync
plugins.description: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a dedicated git mirror of the session store, append-only three-way merge with keep-both + fork conflict resolution, /sync command, sync_pull/sync_push/sync_status tools, and configurable auto push/pull
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-xdpool
plugins.title: dsh-xdpool
plugins.description: One DSH model pool for every free quota you have: merge all locally signed-in WorkBuddy accounts with auto-failover, sign in to 13 vendors by QR/web, aggregate 76 vendors' free tiers, plus a usage dashboard, model routing, a local OpenAI-compatible gateway and a points-automation suite.
plugins.author: XDTrees

plugins.name: @xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup
plugins.title: @xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup
plugins.description: 一条命令备份、恢复与迁移 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的全部数据（~/.dsh：会话、设置、插件、MCP、技能）：定时自动备份、升级前快照、换机迁移、会话日志体检修复、宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援；凭据默认脱敏只存本机。 Backup, restore & migrate all DeepSeek Harness (~/.dsh) data — sessions, settings, plugins, MCP, skills: scheduled backups, pre-upgrade snapshots, cross-machine migration, session-log doctor, out-of-process rescue console; credentials redacted to a local-only vault.

description.en: Connect Qoder CLI's model service: per-region model toggles, context windows, quota lookup, and daily check-in.
description.zh: 接入 Qoder CLI 的模型服务：双区域模型开关、上下文窗口、额度查询与每日签到。

plugins.name: dsh-md-notes
plugins.title: dsh-md-notes
plugins.description: A note-taking plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It provides a full MD notes manager and MD notes editor, letting you quickly capture conversation content into notes. Notes can be maintained by syncing to a Git repository.

plugins.name: dsh-output-styles
plugins.title: dsh-output-styles
plugins.description: Claude Code outputStyles-equivalent runtime output-style switching for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-translate
plugins.title: dsh-translate
plugins.description: Vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: the /translate command maps temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors, and the tools/post-execute repair layer (plus the fix_json tool) fixes broken JSON tool output with escape repair, trailing-comma removal, truncation closure, and required-field completion — never fabricating data
plugins.author: PerryLink

description.en: Let agents search, read, and cite your local Zotero library: find papers, browse notes and annotations, pull evidence by question, open the source document, generate citations.
description.zh: 让智能体搜索、阅读并引用本地 Zotero 知识库：检索论文、浏览笔记与批注、按问题提取证据片段、打开本地文献原文、生成多格式引文。

plugins.name: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck
plugins.title: dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck
plugins.description: 安装即自带mattpocock/skills v1.3.1的27个工程与效率技能，无需手动装技能。400亿token打造本插件，在原始技能之上提供10倍的开发效率，也能帮助新手更快上手该技能套件。全力支持GitHub issue；Markdown为预览版；GitLab暂不支持。感谢您的使用和支持💗

plugins.name: dsh-agent-message
plugins.title: dsh-agent-message
plugins.description: 跨会话 Agent 通信：让 DeepSeek Harness 里不同的 Agent 会话互相收发消息。

plugins.name: dsh-library
plugins.title: dsh-library
plugins.description: Local document knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: library_add/remove/list, hybrid semantic+keyword library_search with diversity re-ranking, relevance filtering and lost-in-the-middle avoidance, citation-aware injection, library_cite_check and library_diagnose —SQLite-backed index via the storage domain, local embedding, zero model downloads
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: memory-eternal
plugins.title: memory-eternal
plugins.description: 记忆核心（Memory Eternal）：自研的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件，不移植任何既有记忆框架——对话结束后自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown Vault（自研去重、自研 CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库（统计 / 搜索 / 知识图谱 + 侧边栏一键弹窗），Agent 通过 memory_recall 工具按需召回历史上下文。零人工干预。
plugins.author: EternalNight996

plugins.name: dsh-memento
plugins.title: dsh-memento
plugins.description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — a capability seam (ctx.memory service + local SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection), not another memory warehouse

plugins.name: dsh-vision-proxy
plugins.title: dsh-vision-proxy
plugins.description: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription for DeepSeek Harness: a deepseek-vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text before delegating to the text-only DeepSeek adapter. Official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives, never hangs.
plugins.author: Flyvhidbwo

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.title: dsh-mcp-panel
plugins.description: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command with health diagnostics and pipeline trial calls, a Settings MCP tab with server CRUD (append-only profile-patch fragments, approval-gated writes with automatic backups), a tool trial console over the official tool pipeline, connection status, reconnect counts and sanitized tool inventory, plus an optional Streamable HTTP probe.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-mineru
plugins.title: dsh-pdf-mineru
plugins.description: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.

plugins.name: @yangdcm/dsh-expert-team
plugins.title: @yangdcm/dsh-expert-team
plugins.description: dsh「专家团」bundle：一句自然语言组建角色化多智能体「数字员工」团队，按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，实现者直接改代码并产出持久工件；带 live 团队浮层。 · Role-based multi-agent expert team for DeepSeek Harness: one sentence in, a staged and gated team delivery out.

plugins.name: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.title: dsh-doublecheck
plugins.description: Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery, and gate the handoff with a deliverable/rework decision.
plugins.author: PerryLink

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
plugins.title: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
plugins.description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/border/opacity, custom typography and caret, and a liquid-glass makeover of the whole settings window. Prerequisite: DeepSeek Harness kernel >= 0.1.5 (0.1.5-rc.1+ — the official desktop line and DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7 both qualify). No version restriction on dsh-better-sidebar.

description.en: Add Xiaomi MiMo text-to-speech, audio history and downloads, browser speech fallback, and optional UI sound effects to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 Xiaomi MiMo 语音朗读、音频历史与下载、浏览器本地语音兜底和可选 UI 音效。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.title: dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.description: Automated plugin supply-chain security gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): eight agent skills in Chinese and English editions teach the audit methodology, and the plugin_vet tool executes the pre-install gate (license / SBOM / commit pinning / malicious patterns / five-dimension risk card) with findings that cite the matching skill sections.

description.en: Connect WorkBuddy's model service: per-region model toggles, context windows, quota lookup, and daily check-in.
description.zh: 接入 WorkBuddy 的模型服务：双区域模型开关、上下文窗口、额度查询与每日签到。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-retry-settings
plugins.title: dsh-llm-retry-settings
plugins.description: DSH 插件：LLM 自动重试设置卡片——重试次数/退避/抖动与 30 个错误码可勾选（也能自己输入），可按 provider/model 单独设策略、尊重上游 Retry-After 建议、回答被输出 token 上限截断时自动续写且提示词可改，内置重试观测面板，改完实时生效。

plugins.name: @openmaic/dsh-openmaic
plugins.title: @openmaic/dsh-openmaic
plugins.description: OpenMAIC for DeepSeek Harness: generate classrooms and render slides, interactive widgets, teaching cards, plus a Socratic teaching skill

plugins.name: dsh-tool-gitbash
plugins.title: dsh-tool-gitbash
plugins.description: 用于替代原生pwsh的gitbash Model-facing Git Bash tool for Windows (replaces pwsh/WSL-bash)
